request.spec: The money I am owed should only count invoices I have actually sent. Do not count drafts.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The money I am owed should only count invoices I have actually sent. Do not count drafts.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes.

The change request — "the money I am owed should only count invoices I have actually sent; do not count drafts" — is implemented. The dashboard's outstanding total was summing invoices with a stale `UNPAID` status (a token that no longer exists since the lifecycle became DRAFT→SENT→PAID). I changed `GetDashboard` to sum only `SENT` invoices, which excludes both DRAFTs (not yet sent) and PAID (already settled).

The DB status column/index and the front-end `dashboard-outstanding-total` element already existed, so no migration or UI change was needed — the single-file server logic change was the whole fix. The acceptance spec passes: with SENT $100 + SENT $200 counted and the $50 DRAFT and $30 PAID excluded, the total reads **$300.00**.
